description: Maps each intentionally-invalid Inventory example to the constraint it must violate. The reference validator test suite asserts every file fails, and fails FOR THE STATED REASON. 'layer' is 'schema' when the JSON Schema (Common envelope + inventory, composed) rejects it, or 'semantic' when the document is schema-valid but violates an envelope prose rule the reference validator enforces.

cases.reason: An item does not identify its paint.
A paint carries neither manufacturer nor name.
condition is outside the controlled vocabulary.
The private object contains a field outside the defined set.
A non-standard top-level member is present; extra data must be namespaced under extensions.
Schema-valid, but two items claim the same document-local anchor. Two items may describe the same paint; they may not share one ref.
An item that is not owned must be wanted; one that is neither records nothing.
An item that is not owned carries a quantity, which describes a bottle in hand.
An item that is not owned carries a private storage location, which describes a bottle in hand.
